subject: Next steps — mutual plan timeline & legal redline ownership (Finexa)
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@finexa.com>, Gavin Holt <gavin.holt@finexa.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps — mutual plan timeline & legal redline ownership (Finexa)

Hi Sara / Gavin — great conversation today, thanks for taking the time. Recap + proposed owners/turnaround for the MAP milestone you asked about. Please flag anything I missed.

Summary of ask
- Finexa is prioritizing final MSA + DPA language and an SLA carve for availability (application tier).
- You requested clarity on who will own redlines and expected TATs so procurement can schedule approvals.

Proposed MAP milestones (draft)
1) MAP initial draft shared (done) — owner: Redwood (Connor) — status: complete
2) Customer legal redline MSA/DPA — owner: Finexa Legal (Sara/Gavin) — requested TAT: 5 business days from receipt
3) Redwood redline and response to customer edits — owner: Redwood Legal (Karthik) — proposed TAT: 3 business days for initial pass, 5 business days for final sign-off after rebuttals
4) SLA negotiation (availability, incident response) — owner: Joint (Redwood product + Finexa ops) — dependency: customer to provide target RTO/RPO and critical endpoints
5) Exec approval / signatures — owner: Sales + Legal leads (Marissa + Sara) — target close date: 2026-03-31

Key notes / constraints
- For efficiency, Redwood is happy to take the first formal redline on the MSA if Finexa prefers that route. Either approach is fine — just want a single owner and explicit TATs so we can keep the MAP timeline.
- If a redline creates scope changes (e.g., add-on logging retention), we will call it out as a separate change request with impact on price and schedule.

Attachments / links
- MAP draft: https://drive.google.com/finexa/Mutual-Action-Plan-v0.9 (sheet)
- Initial MSA starting point (Redline v1 attached): Finexa_MSA_redline_v1.docx [attachment stub]
- SLA summary points (pdf) — attached

Next steps (please reply with confirmations)
- Sara/Gavin: confirm if Finexa will do the first redline or if Redwood should take the initial formal redline. If Finexa wants to redline, confirm expected TAT.
- Karthik / Redwood Legal: standing by to respond within proposed TATs once we get Finexa redlines.

Thanks — I’ll keep the MAP sheet updated as we get confirmations.

Connor O'Brien

Subject: Re: Next steps — mutual plan timeline & legal redline ownership (Finexa)

Connor — thanks for the clear recap. Prefer Finexa to do the first redline so our procurement note speaks to the initial asks. Proposed timing below.

What we can commit to
- Finexa Legal will provide an initial redline of the MSA & DPA by end of business Friday, 2026-03-13 (5 business days).
- We will mark any change-requests that materially impact scope/cost.

Requests back to Redwood
- Please confirm Redwood Legal can commit to an initial response within 3 business days and a final negotiated position within 7 business days from when we return our redline. If an item escalates, we expect both legal leads to be on a quick sync.
- Can you add targeted SLA language for availability (99.9% per month), incident notification timing (within 1 hour) and a template for credits? If possible, include in the next Redwood pass so we can comment inline.

Attachments: we are uploading our procurement checklist separately. In the meantime, attaching a short set of high-priority clauses for alignment.

Sara Lim
Senior Procurement Manager | Finexa
sara.lim@finexa.com

Subject: Re: Next steps — mutual plan timeline & legal redline ownership (Finexa)

Sara / Connor / Karthik — quick confirmation from our side and a slight refinement to avoid timeline drift.

Commitments from Redwood
- Redwood Legal (Karthik) will return a first-pass response to Finexa redlines within 3 business days of receipt (as requested).
- If Finexa flags SLA credit amounts or RTO/RPO numbers that require product review, Redwood product (Dev) will target a technical review within 2 business days and provide proposed language in the same 3 business day window where feasible.
- Redwood requests that any new scope items be surfaced in the MAP as a separate line item with an owner and acceptance criteria so pricing and schedule impacts are explicit.

Escalation path / enforcement
- If any party misses the committed TATs by more than 3 business days without written notice and a reasonable justification, the deal owner (Marissa) gets notified and we trigger an executive sync between procurement/legal leads.

Target close date remains 2026-03-31 provided both sides meet the TATs above. We will update the MAP sheet with owners and the agreed TATs after Sara confirms Finexa redline ETA.

Thanks — I’ll add the SLA bullets into the MAP and link the redline doc once Karthik posts his response.
